{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Slafcourse.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A slafcourse aboard the ''Kuari Princess'']]
A '''slafcourse''' was a recreational activity where participants rode [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] [[Slaf sled|sleds]] through an [[impeller field]] course. Points were scored for the time taken to complete the course, and how many "ports" they successfully navigated through during their run.<ref name="Riders">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref> A [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] version was also available.<ref name="GoA">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref> The [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] boasted a full size 20-port slafcourse onboard.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
